question: Which Indian state is set to get its first nuclear power plant under the National Nuclear Energy Mission?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Bihar to get its first nuclear power plant as part of national SMR rollout.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Bihar** will soon host its **first nuclear power plant**, under the **National Nuclear Energy Mission**.

 
 
• 
 
It is among the **first six states** selected for this initiative.

 
 
• 
 
The goal is to **diversify India’s energy mix** and boost **regional energy security**.

 
 
• 
 
The project will involve **advanced technologies** like **Small Modular Reactors (SMRs)**.

 
 
• 
 
**SMRs** are compact nuclear reactors with up to **300 MW** capacity—about **one-third** of traditional nuclear plants.

 
 
• 
 
A separate **1,000 MW battery storage project** has also been approved in **Bihar**.

 
 
• 
 
The government will provide **₹18 lakh per MW** as **viability gap funding** for the battery storage project.

 
 
• 
 
Announced in the Union Budget 2025-26 with a Rs 20,000 crore allocation, the Nuclear Energy Mission aims at expanding clean and reliable nuclear power across the country and strengthen regional energy security.
